tr=ns['transform']
def blank(h,w,b): return [[b]*w for _ in range(h)]
def add(g,coords,v):
    for r,c in coords:g[r][c]=v
# Demo 1
x1=blank(9,9,4); add(x1,[(2,1),(7,6)],1)
y1=blank(9,9,4); add(y1,[(r,1+(r-2)) for r in range(2,8)],1)
# Demo 2
x2=blank(8,11,8); add(x2,[(1,6),(6,1)],1); add(x2,[(3,4)],6)
y2=blank(8,11,8); add(y2,[(1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1)],1); add(y2,[(r,r+1) for r in range(8)],6)
# restore crossing center as 6, per demo
# Above 1 diagonal has (3,4); correct output retains 6 there
y2[3][4]=6
# demo 3
x3=blank(9,12,4); add(x3,[(1,7),(7,1)],1); add(x3,[(6,7)],6)
y3=blank(9,12,4); add(y3,[(r,8-r) for r in range(1,8)],1); add(y3,[(6,7)],6)
# demo 4
x4=blank(15,12,5); add(x4,[(3,1),(9,7)],1); add(x4,[(2,9),(5,3),(8,6),(13,4)],6)

# original off-line 6s plus active centers

for i,(x,y) in enumerate([(x1,y1),(x2,y2),(x3,y3),(x4,y4)],1):
